children: of David T. Young as CFO and Director, effective September 21, 2026. Former CFO Dan O’Brien has stepped down from the board and executive role to transition to Vice President of Finance.

Young brings over 25 years of investment, capital markets, and operational experience to the post, having previously served as Chief Restructuring Officer at Royal Helium Ltd. His career also includes roles as Principal at The Carlyle Group and Director at Talara Capital Management, along with advisory positions at Perella Weinberg Partners and Houlihan Lokey.

In connection with his appointment, the company granted Young 1M stock options exercisable at CAD$1.30 per share over five years, alongside 500K performance share units (PSUs) and 500K restricted share units (RSUs) vesting over three years.

title: Pulsar Helium appoints David T. Young as CFO and board member
